about: Claude Code's own decisions on each command (ADR 0043's live check), recorded 2026-10-09 with the rules its adapter writes from executors.json's commands: refused means a permission denial in its result event, ran means the command ran (whatever it then answered). tests/plugins/agent.test.ts holds Claude Code to these, and fails when its version or its rules change, until they're recorded again.
how: Install the pinned version into a scratch folder (npm install -g --prefix <dir> @anthropic-ai/claude-code@<version>), build the adapter's argv for a run (claude -p --permission-mode acceptEdits, its commands, folders and look tools, --model haiku), and give it a prompt that runs each command below with the Bash tool exactly as written, in a scratch git repo with a remote, a Makefile with a verify target, a README.md and a .ts file. Signed in on a PC: a claude -p inside a run can't sign in.
refused: for r in x; do git push; done
if true; then git push; fi
ran: for f in a b; do echo $f; done

read.about: Claude Code's own decisions in the read profile (ADR 0044's live check), recorded 2026-10-09 on the pinned version with the flags its adapter writes for commands.run false, from the run's read/ folder with your files and Shipify's copy as its other folders: the tools it was offered, what it read, and what it was refused (a permission denial in its result event). A command and a web fetch it can't even try: it has no tool for them.
